paragraphs: The 750i sits at the performance end of the 7 Series petrol range, using the N63TU twin-turbo V8 across the G11/G12 generation from 2015 to 2022. It's the successor to the earlier N63 engine, with a hot-vee layout — meaning the turbos sit in the valley between the cylinder banks, which creates a distinct set of heat-related wear patterns. The 750i was the mainstream V8 option in the 7 Series line-up, positioned below the V12 M760i but above the six-cylinder 730i/740i models.
about.boldParagraph: The 750i is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.

compatibility.intro: Because the 750i uses a specific generation of the N63 family — the N63TU — fitting the wrong replacement or assuming compatibility with earlier N63 variants risks an expensive mismatch. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:
